name: Tahir Ahmad Bijran
title: Research Intern | Biotechnology | Nanobiotechnology | Computational Biology
tagline: Learning biology deeply. Building with technology. Documenting the journey.
bio: I am a Biotechnology undergraduate interested in the intersection of molecular biology, nanobiotechnology and computational biology.
summary: My academic interests span laboratory biotechnology, biomolecular research, nanomaterials, bioinformatics and AI-assisted biological analysis. I am particularly interested in converting biological questions into practical, reproducible research workflows, from experimental techniques and characterization to computational analysis. Alongside my academic training, I am developing experience in laboratory techniques, scientific data analysis, research documentation and independent computational projects.
education: Undergraduate studies in Biotechnology with an emphasis on molecular and cellular biology, microbiology, physiology, genetics, plant science and laboratory techniques.
goals: Build a strong interdisciplinary foundation for future research in biotechnology and computational life sciences, while turning academic learning into practical, well-documented work.
